author: Jean-Michel Campin <jm-c@users.noreply.github.com>
message:
Enable to use pkg/gmredi with pressure coordinate (#643) * Make changes to use GM-advective with pressure coordinate - Reverse sign of local dSigmaDr (if Z-coord) to always be the same as stratification; this allows to use same piece of code for both P and Z coordinate. - Keep user parameter specification unchanged for P-coord (i.e., same as for Z-coord) and convert locally when needed; e.g., if using P-coords, user parameter GM_maxSlope continues to be unitless. * Update input files (consistent with gravity=10) This is intended to make it easier to compared with similar P-coord set-up. Also provides a second alternative for initial salinity, as a patch in the middle of the domain, to test and illustrate the effect of Redi alone (no GM) on a passive tracer. * Update main model parameters: 1) to make it easier to compare with P-coords similar set-up, set gravity to 10. (instead of 9.81) 2) set-up update (better for this simple front-relaxation illustration of pkg/gmredi): reduce viscosity and use simple harmonic horizontal viscosity (instead of biharmonic), switch off convective adjustment (remove cAdjFreq=-1.,), turn on exactConserv, selectCoriScheme=1 (i.e., Jamar & Ozer, 1995), set vertical interface at the middle between two level center (set delRc instead of delR). 3) improve stability with staggerTimeStep=T and Lax-Wendroff tracer advection scheme: still stable with 1.h time-step (= twice current time-step). * Add secondary test using P-coords. Similar to primary set-up, but for now, only using GM with Advective form (no Redi). Also turns on pkg/diagnostics * update and add new reference output (for front_relax exp) Also switch from globalFiles=T to useSingleCpuIO=T, in new secondary test "in_p" and just when running MPI test (in primary test) with specific "data.mpi" file. * add some doc for GM-Redi in P-coordinate * P-coords: flip sign where Bolus-Transp is computed * update a comment (left from earlier commit) * Make changes to Redi-tensor for P-coordinate: - change sign of local dSigmaDr (now: downward gradient of neutral density) to be the same as stratification (i.e., positive if stratified) - update most of tapering schemes and Redi tensor calculation to work in pressure coordinate ; this include flipping sign of extra-diagonal terms (-gravitySign) if using P-coord. - add new argument "rDepth" to S/R GMREDI_SLOPE_LIMIT for 'ldd97' tapering. - some minor edits (replace "0." with 0. _d 0 or zeroRL, more consitent ordering of terms in sum). * add new check & stop for P-coord * Change threshold to 14 for OpenAD test exp. global_ocean.90x40x15 - The code changes in pkg/gmredi do not affect the forward output; no changes were seen in neither TAF adm nor tlm output. But it's likely that minor changes in OpenAD generated code leads to small machine truncation differences. global_ocean.90x40x15 OpenAD experiment is the only test that shows any differences, from 16 to 14 matching digit for the Ad-Grad. - since 14 digits is still very good (e.g., for daily regression test on reference machine "villon" the threshold is 13), change this exp. precision threshold form 16 to 14 (instead of updating the reference output). * Improve comment wording Thanks to @mjlosch * adjust new secondary exp. to also test Redi in P-coord - change to uniform tRef in both primary and secondary "in_p" tests (better when using P-coordinate) - change secondary test "in_p" to also use Redi isopycnal diffusion (and keep GM with advective form); adjust list of diagnostics output. * update reference output * Update and improve README file - use markdown (+ rename with suffix ".md") - describe the 5 set-up - list which part of pkg/gmredi is used in each of them. - add "Notes" about comparing P & Z coord. * reduce number of html and markdown tags for better ascii readibility - lines length below 80 characters - replace bold font and italics mostly by backward quotes to mark "code" as in the manual - replace explicity line breaks (
) by new lines, etc. - make units not use italics (this does not improve ascii readibility) * fix some math rendering issue * typos and minor writing changes * fix translation from French * Define conversion factor between vertical coordinate (r <-> z) - store "rhoRef" vertical profile (reference density from tRef,sRef) to use it in ocean P-coord Quasi-Hydrostatic conversion (replacing "rhoConst"); - define and store vertical profile at level center to convert "r" unit to "z" unit, similar to already used conversion factor at level interface; - minor (in set_ref_state.F): rename local variable "pRefLocF" to "pRefIntF" (in case we want to store it). * Use more precise conversion factor for P-coord. - new integer argument kPos) to S/R GMREDI_SLOPE_LIMIT to indicate the position (relative to grid-cell center) where slope and tapering fct are evaluated. - use model unit conversion factor (fct of density vertical profile "rhoRef") to convert from P-coord to Z-coord inside slope-limiter and tapering fct. * simplify units with exponent all in 1 math expression, no needs for weird extra spacing within units * document changes in pkg/gmredi for P-coord Co-authored-by: mjlosch Co-authored-by: JEFFERY SCOTT

message:
Added PTRACERS package

This allows an arbitrary number of passive tracers to be integrated
forward simultaneously with the dynamicaly model.
 + Implemented so far:
    - basic forward algorithm (time-stepping, advection, diffusion, convection)
    - I/O and checkpointing
    - GM/Redi  *but*  using the GM/Redi coefficient of Salt
 + Not implemented so far:
    - KPP
    - OBCS
 + No specific example supplied (yet) but global_ocean.90x40x15 has the
   necessary data.ptracer file. Simply use -enable=ptracers and uncomment
   line in data.pkg. PTRACER01 then reproduces Salt exactly.
 + This package is disabled by default since it increases storage.

and some formatting

* change value of ncvarindex to be iArr for generic control variables

and zero for other active control variables (currently only obcs)

- all ecco_cost/ctrl-files in verification remain unchange (by
  comparing output of cksum)

consistent, otherwise the mode stops.

message:
fix Tapenade Makefile (#935)

* fix Tapenade Makefile

Put all adjoint (or Tang.Lin) tapenade generated fortran files "*_b.f" (or "*_d.f")
into a single "adj/tlm/_tap_all.f" file ; compile this file to generate an
object file that is used at the link stage to produce the executable:
 - no need to "touch" the "*_b.f" (or "*_d.f") ; remove the .PHONY targets.
   this avoids to re-process all file through Tapenade and recompile when
   nothing has been updated (restore the purpose of a Makefile).
 - could use specific compiler options for compiling vs link stage

* add an "-ncad" for Tapenade Makefile

Similar to "-ncad" for TAF Makefile, avoid putting all AD code in a single file
and instead append FWD individual src file to corresponding Tapenade-generated AD file.

* sort out `adStack.c` and `abBinomial.c` cases:

remove specific lists `TAPENADE_SUPPORT_C_SRC_FILES` and `TAP_SUPPORT_OBJFILES`
and link a subset of files from `tools/ADFirstAidKit/` directly into build dir,
the same way all links to build dir are done in `genmake2`.

* simpler solution for adStack.c & abBinomial.c

put symbolic-links in pkg/tapenade/

* add description/comments

* changes required to make this work on case-insensitive filesystem

- e.g. for MacOS (where this was tested)
- replace default extension ".f" by ".$FS" in AD_FILES (could also be
  done in more places for consistency)
- add hard coded suffix rule ".f.o".; if FS=f then this will lead to
  having this rule twice, so we could think of a more clever way of
  doing this
- replace "*_b.f *_d.f" by "\$(AD_FILES_ADJ) \$(AD_FILES_TLM)" in
  AD_CLEAN; probably has no effect as I do not see where this is
  used (but it should be)
- back out extension FS for list of files passed to append_fwd_src and
  use it

* replace adj/tlm_tap_all.f by adj/tlm_tap_all.$FS

more consistent and maybe even safer, can use the rule for .$FS.o instead
of hard coded .f.o-rule

* refine description of how to run tapenade with MITgcm on a Mac

with docker. This may actually also apply to other platforms because
there is nothing specfic for MacOS (but not tested).

* alternative way of dealing with ".for" suffix

special case when Fortran suffix ".for" is used instead of ".f" is done
in "append_fwd_src" where output is renamed to _b.$FS or _d.$FS

* permute append_fwd_src first 2 arguments

* add a somewhat complicated TAPENADECMD to MacOS build option file

basically a docker command that requires docker to be running, but
circumnavigates issues with absolute paths in combination with command
tapenadocker (see documentation). With this build options file I can
run the tapenade experiment with docker "out of the box"

* document fixing Tapenade Makefile

     to allow implicit computation of land & sea-ice surface temp.
  b) add snow precipitation.

message:
Two packages:  bulk_forcing (Bulk forcing)
and thermodynamic_seaice (adapted from LANL CICE.v2.0.2)
Earlier integration from Stephaine Dutkiewicz
and Patrick Heimbach.

Two ifdef statements for compile time,
ALLOW_TSEAICE and ALLOW_BULKFORMULA

Two switches in data.pkg to turn on at run-time:

cat data.pkg
# Packages
 &PACKAGES
 useBulkf=.TRUE.,
 useTSeaIce=.TRUE.,
 &

The bulk package requires an additional parameter file
with two namelists.

 cat data.blk
 &BULKF_PARM01
 RainFile=       'ncep_precip_m_cubed.bin',
 SolarFile=      'ncep_downsolr_cubed.bin',
 AirTempFile=    'ncep_tair_cubed.bin',
 AirhumidityFile='ncep_qair_g_cubed.bin',

 UWindFile=      'ncep_uwind_cubed.bin',
 VWindFile=      'ncep_vwind_cubed.bin',
 WspeedFile=    ' ',
 RunoffFile=    ' ',
 QnetFile=       ' ',
 EmPFile=        'ncep_emp_calc_cubed.bin',
 CloudFile=      'ncep_totalcloud_cubed.bin',
 &

 &BULKF_PARM02
 qnet_off=0.0,
 empmr_off=0.0,
 conservcycle=311040000.,
 &



c ADAPTED FROM:
c LANL CICE.v2.0.2
c-----------------------------------------------------------------------
c.. thermodynamics (vertical physics) based on M. Winton 3-layer model
c.. See Bitz, C. M. and W. H. Lipscomb, 1999:  "An energy-conserving
c..       thermodynamic sea ice model for climate study."  J. Geophys.
c..       Res., 104, 15669 - 15677.
c..     Winton, M., 1999:  "A reformulated three-layer sea ice model."
c..       Submitted to J. Atmos. Ocean. Technol.

c.. authors Elizabeth C. Hunke and William Lipscomb
c..         Fluid Dynamics Group, Los Alamos National Laboratory
c-----------------------------------------------------------------------

author: Jean-Michel Campin <jm-c@users.noreply.github.com>
message:
Coding style example (#550)

* Add description of header file content.

* minor lower/upper case change

just to be consistent with header file "SIZE.h"

* remove "\bv" / "\ev"

* call PRINT_MESSAGE and PRINT_ERROR with myThid arg.

Replace hard coded "1" with "myThid" in PRINT_MESSAGE and PRINT_ERROR calls.
This has no consequences here since these calls are within
BEGIN_MASTER / END_MASTER block (and therefore myThid is equal to 1).
But, as a template for writing new code, can easyly forgot to place these Master-Only
restrictions resulting in confusing/misleading printed message if hard coded to 1.

* minor update to S/R description

- add one comment line after "IMPLICIT NONE" to indicate included "Global variables"
- replace "CBOP 0" with just "CBOP" at the start of S/R description

* improve alignment

* remove #ifdef ALLOW_MYPACKAGE from most files

Files that are sitting in pkg/mypackage are only compiled when this pkg is added
to "packages.conf" and, in this case, ALLOW_MYPACKAGE is automaticly "defined",
making this CPP test superfluous.
The exceptions are:
1) MYPACKAGE_OPTIONS.h, to make sure that this pkg CPP options are kept undef
   when this pkg is not compiled.
2) src files that are likely to be customized (with a copy in local "code" dir) in
   which case they might be compiled even when this pkg is removed from "packages.conf".
   mypackage_calc_rhs.F and mypackage_diagnostics_state.F illustrate this situation.

* fix previous commit

* document edits in pkg/mypackage

author: Jean-Michel Campin <jm-c@users.noreply.github.com>
message:
Update ptracers gen ctrl and add 1 missing diagnostics fill (#447)

* Add ptracers to "ctrl_map_ini_genarr.F"

- Use as standard version the local version, from global_oce_biogeo_bling/code_ad,
  which includes changes for ptracers gen-ctrl ;
- This allows to remove the local customized version there and keep (and maintain)
  a single version of this source code.

* Cleaning:

- remove few unused local variables;
- improve indentation;
- at top of src file, add "Content" section with list of S/R that this file contains
- many lower-case changed to upper-case (consistent with standard rules)

* Add filling of diagnostics: 'Um_ImplD' & 'Vm_ImplD'

Diagnostics of momentum dissipation/viscous tendency, implicit part, are filled up
in S/R MOM_U/V_IMPLICIT_R ; however, when pkg/autodiff is compiled, these 2 S/R are
not called but instead the (old) IMPLDIFF S/R is called for implicit vertical viscosity.
The filling of these 2 diagnostics is added to the (old) impldiff.F file to
allow to use these diagnostics even when pkg/autodiff is compiled.

* Make ptracers gen-control more general

More general way to deal with number of ptracers generic-control:
- extend to any ptracers number from 1 to 9, ctrl file: xx_ptr1 -> xx_ptr9 ;
- reduce number of lines of code (less prone to mistake);
- no risk of exceeding Total number of tracers (PTRACERS_num, PTRACERS_numInUse);
- since this check for the length of ctrl file, can easily be extended to, e.g.,
  10+ ptracers (with 2 digit number) or 100+ ptracers (with 3 digit number).

* Remove ptracer TAF store directive

- Also remove tamc.h & AUTODIFF_OPTIONS.h (no longer needed) and GMREDI_OPTIONS.h
  which was unnecessary .
- add missing ALLOW_DIFFKR_CONTROL around difKr control.

* Remove local version of "ctrl_map_ini_genarr.F"

- Remove local version of  "ctrl_map_ini_genarr.F" in code_ad and use instead
  the new reference version from pkg/ctrl (which now has ptracers as gen-ctrl).
- Update "data.ctrl" and use file for 3-D "weigth", uniformly equal to one,
  linked (by prepare_run)to a much bigger set-up to save disk space.
- Also take forcing and other binary files from exp2 (since identical to input/
  content).

* Little cleaning

- bring local version of ptracers_forcing_surf.F up-to-date with reference
  version in pkg/ptracers;
- remove all content of input/ dir (no longer used).

* Renamed files used for pkg/ctrl weight

Currently, these binary input files only contain the value "one" and are used
in pkg/ctrl to specify a weight. Pick standard names: "ones_32b.bin" and "ones_64b.bin"
for, respectively, the 32-bits and the 64-bits versions.

Also, in order to save disk space, use the copy for the larger domain-size experiment
(currently: isomip for 64-bits version and global_oce_biogeo_bling for the 32-bits version)
for smaller domain-size experiments, making a symbolic link with "prepare_run".

* Fix previous commit

forgot to replace one more file name, this time in "data.ecco"

* Count errors and stop (if any) at the end

also improve indentation + few comments, more consistent upper/lower case writing,
and minor improvement to printed messages.

* Add check & stop for ptracer gen-ctrl

* Fix a typo

mis-spelling #undef does not have any real impact since it's not defined anyway
but fixing it get rid of a CPP error report (invalid preprocessing directive #unde)

* minor edits around CPP options

* document ptracers generic-control update

author: Ou Wang <Ou.Wang@jpl.nasa.gov>
message:
Add and update some files related to ECCO v4 release 3. The main changes are
 adding cost_gencost_glbmean.F to compute the costs for global mean time-series of OBP
 & SSH, splitting the profile cost to sample-mean and -anomaly parts,
 updating the cost formula for the proxy sea-ice costs, adding initial velocity
 as part of the control variables, and applying the correction of global
 mean steric height change to OBP.
- cost_gencost_glbmean.F:    compute cost for global mean OBP & SSH time-series
- cost_profiles.F:           add a CPP option (ALLOW_PROFILES_SAMPLESPLIT_COST)
                              that if defined splits the profile cost to
                              sample-mean and sample-anomaly costs.
- cost_gencost_seaicev4.F:   add a CPP option (SEAICECOST_JPL) that if defined
                             reads in the weights for the proxy sea-ice costs.
- cost_gencost_curstomize.F: if ALLOW_PSBAR_STERIC is defined, correct OBP with
                              the global mean steric ssh change to be consistent
                              with SSH.
- ecco_phys.F:               include sterGloH in a common block to be used in
                              cost_gencost_customize.F to correct OBP when
                              ALLOW_PSBAR_STERIC is defined.
- ctrl_map_ini_genarr.F:     add CPP options to include initial UV as the control
                              variables.
- cost_gencost_all.F:        changes related to cost for the global mean time-series.
- cost_gencost_bpv4.F:       minor change related to cost for the global mean time-series.
- ecco_readparms.F:          changes related to cost for the global mean time-series.
- ecco_ad_diff.list:         include the new added cost_gencost_glbmean.F.
- ctrl_get_gen.F:            check if the first seven characters of xx_tauu_file &
                              xx_tauv_filei matches "xx_tauu" or "xx_tauv".
- ecco_cost_final.F:         add modification related to the sample-mean profile cost.
- ecco_cost_init_fixed.F:    initialize the data and weights for the global mean costs
                              for OBP & SSH, if ALLOW_GENCOST_1D is defined.
- profiles_readvector.F:     read in climatology field in the profile file, and mask
                              out the weight where climatology data is flagged. Active
                              if ALLOW_PROFILES_CLIMMASK is defined.
- PROFILES_SIZE.h:           changes related to the split of profile cost to sample-mean
                              and sample-anomaly.
- profiles.h:                changes related to the split of profile cost to sample-mean
                              and sample-anomaly.
- ecco.h:                    changes related to the global mean costs
- profiles_readparms.F:      changes related to the profile cost splitting and masking
                              by climatology data.
- profiles_init_fixed.F:     changes related to the profile cost splitting.
- profiles_init_varia.F:     changes related to the profile cost splitting.

author: Martin Losch <30285667+mjlosch@users.noreply.github.com>
message:
Verif adj ctrl gen (#406)

* replace ECCO_CPPOPTIONS.h with package specific header files

* move ctrlprec into namelist for data.ctrl

- CPP flag CTRL_SET_PREC_32 still sets the default value for backward
  compatibility, but now it can be changed in data.ctrl

* change experiment so that is uses new runtime flag ctrlprec

* add CTRL_SIZE.h in preparation of switching to GENARR_CONTROL

* switch offline_exf_seaice to generic control variables
- undefine ECCO_CTRL_DEPRECATED and define ALLOW_GEN*_CONTROL
- modify data.ctrl and data.grdchk accordingly
- there are severe problems with this: (1) unclear why this affects
  the cost function value of offline_exf_seaice (only 4 digits of
  agreement left), and (2) the adjoint gradients and grdchks fail
  entirely, because the adxx_files contain only half of the
  information. Note that the gradient is correct and identical to
  before this change (checked via adjDumpFreq output). The problem is
  related to ctrlprec (= 32 in this experiment). Setting it to 64
  leads to correct adxx_files, but (expectly) only to
  Y Y Y Y  4> 8< 8 FAIL  offline_exf_seaice  (e=0, w=37)
  Y Y Y Y 16> 7< 8 FAIL  offline_exf_seaice.thsice
  So somewhere in writing these adxx_files, there's a bug.

* add and specify weight file with proper floating point precision

- this fixes the problem with the adxx_files, still the cost function
  value and consequently the gradient check numbers are not good for
  the first experiment:
  Y Y Y Y  4>16< 9 pass  offline_exf_seaice  (e=0, w=37)
  Y Y Y Y 16>16<16 pass  offline_exf_seaice.thsice

* switch 4 global_ocean.cs32x15 experiments to GEN*_CONTROL
- remove duplicate namelists
- adjust CTRL_OPTIONS.h and new CTRL_SIZE.h
- adjust data.ctrl and data.grdchk
- breaks all experiments, not clear why:
Y Y Y Y  4> 8< 8 FAIL  global_ocean.cs32x15  (e=0, w=49)
Y Y Y Y  3> 4< 4 FAIL  global_ocean.cs32x15.seaice
Y Y Y Y  3> 4< 2 FAIL  global_ocean.cs32x15.seaice_dynmix
Y Y Y Y  3> 4< 4 FAIL  global_ocean.cs32x15.thsice

* make it possible to run GENTIM2D_CONTROL without calendar pkg

- but issue a warning
- as far as I can see, it's possible to run without calendar, if only
  the initial conditions are control

* suppress an annoying recomputation warning for xx_gentim2d_dummy

* enable xx_shifwflx as a control variable with xx_gentim2d

* switch isomip ad experiments to GEN*_CONTROL

* adding the genarr3d_bounds improves the numbers but not quite there yet

- only bounds for xx_theta are required, xx_salt bounds make things
  worse and they are definitely not applied in the reference output,
  very strange. Now the numbers look like this:
Y Y Y Y 10> 9< 8 FAIL  global_ocean.cs32x15  (e=0, w=47)
Y Y Y Y 10> 9< 8 FAIL  global_ocean.cs32x15.seaice
Y Y Y Y  9> 9< 2 FAIL  global_ocean.cs32x15.seaice_dynmix
Y Y Y Y  9> 9< 8 FAIL  global_ocean.cs32x15.thsice

* mask HEFF/HSNOW/AREA in seaice_growth_adx.F, this also fixes the isomip AD experiment and appears to be more
  consistent

* fix tape initialization to reduce number of (benign) taf warnings

* move calling CTRL_GETOBCSN/S/E/W from PRESCRIBE_READ to OBCS_CALC

* make it possible to combine obcs cost function with generic cf

- main change: move obcs-cost related code out of
  ifdef ECCO_CTRL_DEPRECATED blocks
- clean up some CPP flags, unused variables
- get rid off wbaro, it's never used anywhere, just read for dataerr_file

* switch obcs_ctrl to generic cost function and ctrl parameters

- undefine ECCO_CTRL_DEPRECATED
- adjust namelists, requires a new double precision version of the
  weights file errorTtot.err (alternative is to specify ctrlprec=32
  and use the original single precision file, but that leaves only 6
  digits of agreement even for the cost function value)
- add a python script generating the errorTtot.err-files

* remove undefined non-standard CPP-flag ALLOW_IESTAU_COST_CONTRIB*

* switch ALLOW_AUTODIFF_TAMC <-> ALLOW_AUTODIFF in a few places:

- reserved ALLOW_AUTODIFF_TAMC for TAF specific instructions (e.g., storage dirs)
- otherwise, use ALLOW_AUTODIFF (e.g., for simplified logics & flow dependencies)
Also:
- since MaxTsf is only available with ALLOW_AUTODIFF_TAMC, fix thsice_check.F by using the right #ifdef
- remove some un-needed THSICE_TAVE.h
- improve tabulation

* Simplify:

 -Comments out (many) header files which are not needed.
 - substitute "ecco_cost.h" with "ecco.h"
   When ECCO_CTRL_DEPRECATED is not defined, "ecco_cost.h" only includes "ecco.h";
   therefore, in src files where ECCO_CTRL_DEPRECATED is not used, can just include
   directly the smaller header file "ecco.h" instead of through "ecco_cost.h".

* some cleanup without any consequences and more ctrl output

- print ncvarindex of generic control variables
- move some local variables from global header file
- fix print statement

* Move ECCO_CTRL_DEPRECATED to CTRL_OPTIONS.h

1) This CPP options is used in both pkg/ecco & pkg/ctrl ; since pkg/ctrl can be
   used without pkg/ecco, better to have it sitting in CTRL_OPTIONS.h
   (instead of in ECCO_OPTIONS.h) so that it can be #define there when needed.
Note: this was not an issue when all CPP options were all in same file "ECCO_CPPOPTIONS.h"
2) Include CTRL_OPTIONS.h in all pkg/ecco src files that use ECCO_CTRL_DEPRECATED
   (either directly or though header file "ecco_cost.h").
3) Also add missing AUTODIFF_OPTIONS.h in ecco_cost_driver.F & ecco_summary.F
   (to get ALLOW_AUTODIFF_TAMC defined).

* add new runtime flags to replace hardwird masks for generic control

- the flags gen*_grid default to 'c', which is the value to which all
of the generic control variables have been hardwired in ctrl_init.F
- if you set these flags, the length of the control vector is computed
more accurately
- should not have any effect on the solution of an optimization, but
these changes makes previous control vector files incompatible (but
who would update the code in the middle of an optimization?).

* make specifying the mask for generic controls work with shifwflx

- this requires replacing the specific CPP flag ALLOW_SHIFWFLX_CONTROL
with more generic pkg flags such as ALLOW_SHELFICE and ALLOW_CTRL

* Move ECCO_CTRL_DEPRECATED further up

* cleanup CTRL_OPTIONS.h in the four changed verification experiments

- keep ECCO_CTRL_DEPRECATED flags, but comment them out with some
  explanation
- also compile ECCO_CTRL_DEPRECATED code in global_ocean.cs32x15 and
  use in global_ocean.cs32x15.thsice by setting ctrlUseGen=.FALSE. in
  data.ctrl

* adjust the use of ECCO_CTRL_DEPRECATED, caught by @timothyas

* Fix for "ageos" cost contribution

* add a specific data.grdchk with a consistent grdchkvarindex

* add old control variable names and some explanation for future ref.

* fix flow directives and add new tl version of ctrl_bound_2/3d

* Minor adjustment to new WARNING msg

Adjust new WARNING message for the case GENTIM2D_CONTROL is used but useCAL is False
- "set useCAL = .TRUE." might have been interpreted as a report of what the model
  is doing (instead of an advice of what the user should do): clarify
- break line in 2 (was 152 c long)

author: Jean-Michel Campin <jmc@ocean.mit.edu>
message:
Much more accurate pLoc for basal melting

For ice-shelf thermodynamics, change the expression of local pressure (in dBar) at the
bottom of the ice-shelf to be simply the weight of the ice-shelf above. This is more
accurate than previous expression based on (truncated) ice-shelf draft, specially when:
 1) shelficeLoadAnomaly is large (static contribution), e.g., because of hFacMin
    truncation on R_shelfIce ;
 2) significant adjustment of sea-level below the ice-shelf occurs (dynamic contribution).
Also store prognostic variable "shelficeMass" (using TAF store directives) to avoid
major recomputations.

author: Martin Losch <Martin.Losch@awi.de>
message:
introduce new parameter SEAICEscaleSurfStress (default = .FALSE.)
  - if TRUE scale ice-ocean and ice-atmosphere stress acting on sea ice
    by AREA according to Connelly et al. (2004), JPO.
  - For EVP and the LSR solver, the implicit part of the drag term is
    the only non-zero term in the denominator when there is no ice
    (which prevented running the model with zero drag). If
    SEAICEscaleSurfStress = .TRUE., this results in a division by zero
    (or zero main diagonals BU/BV) which needs to be caught. A practical
    consequence is that, for open water, the momentum equation reduce
    to trivially 0 = 0 + 0.

message:
adjust TAF store directives for mom_fluxform.F and mom_vecinv.F, solve_tri/pentadiagonal.F, and calc_phi_hyd.F (#723)

* add more store directives to avoid recomputions (unwarned)

- be more consistent with mom_vecinv.F (add AUTODIFF_ALLOW_VISCFACADJ
  related code)
- do not recompute cDrag, rTransU/V for k>1, v4f
- unfortunately, there is an option recompute KE in
  mom_u/v_botdrag_coeff.F the corresponding shelfice_u/v_drag_coeff,
  which (while unused here) requires multiple storing of KE that
  cannot be avoided

* remove unnecessary stores, store cDrag, reorganize storing hFacZ

- this save some memory overhead, which is eaten up again by storing
  cDrag

* remove recomputation warnings for SOLVE_DIAGONAL_KINNER case

* avoid unnecessary taf-warnings

- about potential conflicts by adding INCOMPLETE statement
- about unused tapes by removing them

* avoid excessive unused gad_som-tape/unnecessary storing warnings

by only compiling gad_som-routine bodies if they are really used. This
requires that GAD_ALLOW_TS_SOM_ADV is also defined for
PTRACERS_ALLOW_DYN_STATE to work, so I add a stop if runtime flags are
not consistent with CPP-flags, and add a local version of
GAD_OPTIONS.h to tutorial_advection_in_gyre

* ECCO does not need the dummytape (anymore)

* exclude some storing with ifndef SEAICE_ALLOW_DYNAMICS

* refine store directives to reduce unnecessary warnings

* exclude routine body if not needed by ALLOW_AUTODIFF

* a few new stores at initialisation for ALLOW_PSBAR_STERIC

* taf store directives do not seem to be necessary

but we leave them commented as a reminder

* comment out a store directive that seems to be unnecessay

* storing climsst is not necessary and only leads to a warning

* remove unnecessary store directives from thsice_ad_check_lev?_dir.h

- they only lead to warnings

* remove unnecessary store directives from seaice_ad_check_lev?_dir.h

- they only lead to warnings

* move storing phi0surf to shelfice_ad_check_lev

because it is only need if shelfice is defined/used

* only GGL90TKE needs to be stored, so remove rest

- not sure if we even need these files

* saltplumeflux need not be stored for levels 2-4

so that the corresponding files are now empty, but we leave them for
now in place.

* remove unnecessary storing of hFacC, recip_hFacC in the_main_loop

* refine storing of rstardh[c,s,w]dt in checkpoint_lev?_directives.h

* reduce "unnecessary" warnings by moving exf-store directives around

and by removing a few

* no storing required in load_fields_driver

* no storing required in kpp_forcing_surf.F

* comment many store directives in dic and bling

but do not remove them because I do not know how much of this may be
needed in configurations other than the tested ones.

* no storing or checkpointing necessary in smooth_diff2/3d.F

operations are strictly linear and AD code is simple

* fix embarrassing typo (thanks Ou!)

* fix indexing bug (thanks to antngynen13 for catching this)

* fix small bug: add ALLOW_AUTODIFF_TAMC around store directives

* avoid double negative in cpp-statement introduced in commit 12ec156

thanks to jm-c for pointing this out

* refine commit 1ee65c6 and adjust check for ptracers

author: Martin Losch <Martin.Losch@awi.de>
message:
add parameter rotateGrid and Euler angles EulerPhi/Theta/Psi. For
 usingSphericalGrid, this allows to define the rotated grid coordinates
 via phiMin/thetaMin/dxSpacing/dySpacing, etc., but then re-compute the
 geographical coordinates according to the inverse of the rotation defined
 by the Euler angles, so that Coriolis parameter and online-interpolation by
 exf works with the geographical coordinates on XC/YC/XG/YG.

 The three Euler angles PhiEuler, ThetaEuler, and PsiEuler
 define the rotation about the original z-axis (of an sphere
 centered cartesian grid), the new x-axis, and the new z-axis,
 respectively.
 Naturally, this feature does not work with all packages, so the
 some combinations are prohibited in config_summary (flt,
 flt_zonal, ecco, profiles), because there the coordinates are
 assumed to be regular spherical grid coordinates.

author: Martin Losch <martin.losch@awi.de>
message:
add cg2d flow directives for common block variables

- these flow directives describe how cg2d depends on common block
  variables of CG2D_I_R (coefficients and preconditioner)
- with these flow directives update_cg2d will always be included in
  tape computations
- This change fixes a serious bug that caused many configurations with
  non-linear free surface and seaice to blow up in tapelevel 1
  computations, because update_cg2d was not called in
  forward_stepmd. As a consequence, this will change the results of AD
  simulations with non-linear free surface
- Note: with this fix, simulations will be more stable, but the
  gradients are still wrong, because cg2d is described as self
  adjoint, which it is not if the non-linear free surface is used.

author: Alistair Adcroft <aadcroft@princeton.edu>
message:
Added PTRACERS package

This allows an arbitrary number of passive tracers to be integrated
forward simultaneously with the dynamicaly model.
 + Implemented so far:
    - basic forward algorithm (time-stepping, advection, diffusion, convection)
    - I/O and checkpointing
    - GM/Redi  *but*  using the GM/Redi coefficient of Salt
 + Not implemented so far:
    - KPP
    - OBCS
 + No specific example supplied (yet) but global_ocean.90x40x15 has the
   necessary data.ptracer file. Simply use -enable=ptracers and uncomment
   line in data.pkg. PTRACER01 then reproduces Salt exactly.
 + This package is disabled by default since it increases storage.

author: Jean-Michel Campin <jm-c@users.noreply.github.com>
message:
Fluid addition with implicDiv2Dflow < 1 (#869)

* add missing implicDiv2Dflow factor

for all "addMass" contributions (both cg2d_b & cg3d_b)

* no addMass for initial (myIter=0) wVel

Do not include "addMass" in the very first (myIter=0) vertical velocity,
similar to what is done for EmP with useRealFreshWaterFlux.

* update check & stop

* add comments

The reason for the condition around the resetting of "addMass" might not be
obvious; better with some explanations.

* add implicDiv2DFlow factor in cg2/3dTolerance

In the case where the cg2d/cg3d Target residual is specified in term of
vertical velocity accuracy ( cg2/3dTargetResWunit ), account for missing
implicDiv2DFlow factor in setting cg2d/cg3dTolerance.

* upgrade "global_ocean.cs32x15.viscA4" test

to test "addMassFile" (and selectAddFluid=1,) with implicDiv2DFlow= 0.5

* update reference output

* mask EmP over land (instead of just in cg2d_b)

When using useRealFreshWaterFlux=T and exactConserv=T, if some pkgs (e.g., pkg/ebm)
put non-zero values over land, this results in non zero EtaN evolution over land.
Fixed by masking EmP.
Note: did not affect CG2D since masking was applied to cg2d_b EmP contribution
 (not necessary anymore).

* forgot to update INTEGRATE_FOR_W call

* fix for special case implicDiv2DFlow=0

In this case there is not much to solve as all except free-surface term
(in solver main diagonal) are zero. And value of cg2dTolerance does not
matter as long as it is > 0 (to allow to return after first cg2d-iter).

* STOP if using implicDiv2DFlow < 1 with exactConserv=F

As done previously for nonHydrostatic and also for useRealFreshWaterFlux or
selectAddFluid > 0 ; remove specific code in calc_div_ghat.F and forward_step.F
(if filtering uvStar), see issue #860

* not needed (xmakedepend is the default)

* remove a few unnecessay and duplicate store directitves

- some are just duplicates, but others may have become unnecessary in
  the PR (or by previous modifiations)
- testreport passes, also for verficiation_other/global_oce_cs32 so I
  believe we are safe.

* improve 1 error message (usePickupBeforeC54)

* simplify

no need for 2 blocks of loops when 1 is enough.

* document implicDiv2Dflow < 1 related updates

message:
Use weight to balance Fresh-Water flux (#587)

* allow to correct non-uniformly for global-mean surf.flux imbalance

- new (integer) parameter "selectBalanceEmPmR" to replace logical param "balanceEmPmR";
- input file name for weight, to be used to apply weighted correction (instead
  of uniform correction) for surf.flux imbalance.

* allow to correct non-uniformly for global-mean surf.flux imbalance

- new 2-D weight array "weight2BalanceFlx" (within #ifdef ALLOW_BALANCE_FLUXES)
- initialised to 1 (default) or from file "wghtBalanceFile"

* allow to correct non-uniformly for global-mean surf.flux imbalance

- for now, without changing argument list, tweak S/R REMOVE_MEAN_RS to also
  correct non-uniformly for global-mean imbalance when argument arrDr(1) < 0.
- when selectBalanceEmPmR=2, correct global-mean EmPmR imbalance by applying
  a weighted correction.

* always initialise "tmpVar" (for Auto-Diff)

* replace "balanceEmPmR" with "selectBalanceEmPmR=1" in pkgs

and remove "balanceEmPmR" from model parameter header file "PARAMS.h"

* add a stop for selectBalanceEmPmR=2

The way to weight correction proportionally to 2-D weight field (selectBalanceEmPmR=2)
has not been implemented in pkg/seaice/seaice_growth.F ; add a stop for this case.

* add new selectBalanceEmPmR and wghtBalanceFile parms to manual table

* slight change in wording for SelectBalanceEmPmR in parm table

* document S/R arguments (+ adjust S/R description)

* improve 1 comment

* Also change _RL version

* document new option to balance Fresh-Water flux non-uniformly

author: Patrick Heimbach <heimbach@mit.edu>
message:
Merging from release1_p8 branch:
o New package: pkg/seaice
  Sea ice model by D. Menemenlis (JPL) and Jinlun Zhang (Seattle).
  The sea-ice code is based on Hibler (1979-1980).
  Two sea-ice dynamic solvers, ADI and LSR, are included.
  In addition to computing prognostic sea-ice variables and diagnosing
  the forcing/external data fields that drive the ocean model,
  SEAICE_MODEL also sets theta to the freezing point under sea-ice.
  The implied surface heat flux is then stored in variable
  surfaceTendencyTice, which is needed by KPP package (kpp_calc.F and
  kpp_transport_t.F) to diagnose surface buoyancy fluxes and for the
  non-local transport term.  Because this call precedes model
  thermodynamics, temperature under sea-ice may not be "exactly" at
  the freezing point by the time theta is dumped or time-averaged.

message:
A hack to fix the "-nocat4d" option with new version of TAF

With new version of TAF (currently 4.2.7), *.flowdir files are now
assumed to be free-format source files (since they don't have either .f
or .F suffix); Up to version 4.1.1 they were assumed to be fixed format.

And when using "-nocat4d" option, we send all individual files to TAF
(instead of a single file: ad_input_code.f); so we need to explicitly
add the "-fixed" option to the TAF command to get the *.flowdir processed
correctly.

author: Jean-Michel Campin <jm-c@users.noreply.github.com>
message:
Fix gmredi under ice-shelf (#593)

* fix masking of gmredi lateral diffusive fluxes

- pass 2D mask maskUp/maskFk as argument to gmredi lateral transport S/R
- apply correct mask in case of dry point near the top (e.g., under ice-shelf)

* fix some masking in case of dry point near the top

- also, for now, comment out unnecessary masking (can put then back if needed).

* Fix masking in case of dry point near the top

* allow to use taper_scheme "ac02":

- for Redi-Tensor, current taper_scheme "ac02" (in gmredi_slope_limit.F)
  is similar to "gkw91" (i.e., 1/|S|^2) but without some small-slope approx.
- here we allows to use Advective form when selecting this taper_scheme (for Redi)
  by just using "gkw91" tapering scheme for bolus stream-function.

* fix "ac02" tapering sheme:

- with this tapering sheme, SlopeX,Y and SlopeSqr were not always set (-> Arithmetic exception with -devel);
  this is now fixed.
- also fix (unlikely) problem in other tapering schemes when SlopeSqr is exactly equal to GM_slopeSqCutoff:
  in this case, taperFct was not set to 0 (since SlopeSqr > GM_slopeSqCutoff not true) and we
  skip calculation of tapering fct (since SlopeSqr < GM_slopeSqCutoff not true neither) leaving taperFct=1.
- minor edits to improve code readability.

* multiply by maskp1 where maskC(kp1) is used

This is not necessary here in FWD routine since when maskp1=0 (i.e., k=Nr)
the tracer difference is already zero (since kp1 = k); but this make the AD routine
cleaner and avoid some machine truncation error in AD tracer update.
This also makes k=1 and k=Nr special cases more similar.

* fix 'stableGmAdjTap' calculation loop range:

- Previously done over full array size execpt for i=1-OLx (?) but all other "slope-limit"
  computations (+ input array setting from gmredi_calc_tensor.F) are done over
  [2-OLx,sNx+OLx-1,2-OLy,sNy+OLy-1]; adopt same loop range as for other tapering scheme.
- This allows to use/try this scheme even when SlopeX,SlopeY are not initialised in
  gmredi_calc_tensor.F (e.g., when ALLOW_AUTODIFF is undef) or when TAF drops these
  initialisations in S/R GMREDI_CALC_TENSORMD.

* Update global_ocean.90x40x15 ad (+ tlm) output

Due to improved masking in gmredi_x/ytransport.F, changes in AD/TL Grad (@ machine trucation level):
 OAD: only 13 digits (previously 16)
 ADM: 13 digits in primary and kapgm test, and 12 digits in kapredi test
 TLM: 13 digits in kapredi test (previously all 16)
Update corresponding reference output.

* New secondary test with some dry cells near the top:

Similar to "input.bvp" setting, with a 50.m bump at the top (topoFile= ...) and with
thinner Mixed layer (only 3 levels). Use GM advective form and "ac02" tapering scheme
(not currently tested in any set-up).

* add reference output for new secondary test "top"

* set BVP_modeNumber to 5 and subMeso_Ceff to 0.03

was previously using default BVP_modeNumber=1 (--> not enough vertical structure)
and default subMeso_Ceff=7.e-2 ; results "look" better after changing these 2 params.

* minor cleaning

update some comments, remove "useKPP=.FALSE.," from data.pkg (since pkg/kpp
is not even compiled).

* Stop if using unsafe features with dry-cells near the top

* rename GM_useK3D to GM_useBatesK3d

* fix Visbeck for dry-cells near the top

- fix Visbeck scheme vertical integral in case with dry cell near the top, by
  integrating over "Visbeck_depth" relative to the top (+ leave comment for
  not going deeper (in absolute sense) than Visbeck_depth).
- nothing to change in OLD_VISBECK_CALC (already mis-count dry cell near bottom
  in vertical averaging).
- change the STOP in gmredi_check.F to a weak warning ; also adjust warning
  for LeithQG.

* fix setting of internal flag "uniformFreeSurfLev"

Mainly used to get correct hFac in computing hydrostatic-pressure under partially dry-cell.
Was set to False if using pkg/shelfice but not when dry cell setting comes from topoFile;
fix this and update ref.output of new test: front_relax.top

it fixes the extensive recomputations. Relative to the version prior
to this PR the speed up is small.

With this commit (on my laptop):

Before:
User/System/Wall clock time:  358.49 sec / 0.35 sec / 360.67 sec

is not visible to taf anyway

flow directives (avoid another warning)

just to avoid un-used variables

author: Martin Losch <30285667+mjlosch@users.noreply.github.com>
message:
Fix usage of ALLOW_AUTODIFF_TAMC/ALLOW_AUTODIFF flags in pkg/seaice (#731)

* fix a compilation error when ALLOW_AUTODIFF_TAMC is undefined

always declare nEVPstepMax in SEAICE_SIZE.h and change one
ALLOW_AUTODIFF_TAMC to ALLOW_AUTODIFF

* change ALLOW_AUTODIFF_TAMC to ALLOW_AUTODIFF where appropriate

allow code to be seen that is not specific to TAF/TAMC, but may help
any AD-tool

* fix previous commit 2cff20b

* move including EXF_OPTIONS.h to where it makes more sense

(before the subroutine declaration)

* skip local common block /WIND_STRESS_ICE/ if ALLOW_AUTODIFF defined

useless in this case since TAUX/Y are always reset at the beginning

* add a stop related to useHB87stressCoupling

stop if useHB87stressCoupling=T with ALLOW_AUTODIFF defined and
SEAICE_deltaTdyn > SEAICE_deltaTtherm (not working properly in this case)

also adjust some comments + writing to msgBuf

* move calling s/r seaice_get_dynforcing out of if-different_multiple

this avoids at least 2 store directives, putting taux/y into a common
block, and awkward initialisation at the cost of computing local
variables taux/y every timestep (even if SEAICE_deltaTdyn > deltaT),
but it also ensures that taux/y is always available to be used in
s/r seaice_ocean_stress

* move ALLOW_DYNAMICS up to include most of the routine body

if ALLOW_DYNAMICS is not defined (or runntime parameter
SEAICEuseDYNAMICS=F), only TAUX/Y are computed (in
seaice_get_dynforcing) and (potentially) applied (in
seaice_ocean_stress).

* minor: upper case / lower case changes

just to be more consistent ;
also improve indentation in seaice_advdiff.F

* rearrange to collect CGRID variables, add more inline documentation

* cut deltaT in half and set SEAICE_deltaTdyn=2*deltaT

This tests the capability of not calling the seaice dynamics solver
every timestep (and changes results, so that an update of the
reference is necessary).

* fix a comment in seaice_get_dynforcing.F

* minor update

cleaner to comment out first (un-used) thSIce_monFreq setting
to make it clear that the second will be used.

* update reference output

new output generated on ref. machine "villon" using gfortran & -devel

* added to get this exp. included in multi-treaded test

* Remove stop that was added earlier

No needs to stop when pkg/autodiff is compiled and deltaTdyn > deltaTtherm
with useHB87stressCoupling=T (now working normally).

Also simplify some check by removing some unnecessary #ifdef (better to have
inconsistency detected early on rather than after re-compiling and running again).

* minor (upper/lower case changes)

* document fixing 2 small issues in pkg/seaice

message:
ppm/pqm-advection schemes for pkg/seaice (#167)

* add new ppm and pqm advection schemes to seaice
  modify offline_exf_seaice and add a preliminary test for new advection
  schemes for debugging purposes
* replace unsafe division by ss1-ss2 with 0.5/(u/vCFL+1e-20)
  This change regularizes the computations against underflows in the
  advective velocities. So far, we do this only for the horizontal ppm
  schemes, until we have decided what to do about this.
* improve regularization a little
* remove print-hallo debugging code
* use the same regularization in all ppm/pqm routines
  replace division by ss22-ss11 by 0.5/sign(max(abs(xCFL),1.d-20),xCFL)
  where x = u,v,w. Note that in vertical flx_r routines, the sign is
  different from the horizontal flx_x/y routines.
* Remove test directory
* revert to original overlap
* test advection scheme 41
* update reference after numerical truncation changed
* update reference to test new advection scheme 41
* document change in ppm/pqm schemes and seaice advection
* add comments near code changes (to clarify).

author: Martin Losch <Martin.Losch@awi.de>
message:
introduce "adaptive EVP" by Madlen Kimmritz
  - this is an intermediate state of a truely converging EVP that has
    the potential of outperforming implicit VP methods, I do not recommend
    using it yet.
  - for now, "adaptive EVP" is turned on by setting SEAICE_EVP_USE_ADAPTATION
    and all parameters are hardwired
  - for convergence it still requires very smooth regularisations, that means,
    if SEAICE_DELTA_SMOOTHREG is defined, deltaCreg=deltaC+deltaMin, which is
    different from the VP case with deltaCreg=sqrt(deltaC**2+deltaMin**2); also
    specific averaging appears to be required, still subject to tuning
  - still needs cleaning and I need to turn parameter into runtime parameters
  - add code to compute and print residuals of iteration, compile with
    defining ALLOW_SEAICE_EVP_RESIDUAL to enable it

Swapped the time-stepping algorithm around (just a little bit).
We now officially use the predictor-corrector terminology.
We make the prediction step at the end of the dynamics() section
and store the result in the gUNm1, gVNm1, gTNm1 arrays.
The "tricky" part is that at the beginning of the dynamics section,
where the "correction" is made, theses arrays must be initialised
at the beginning of any run. A new routine init_predictor() does this.
This is "all" in preparation for implicit diffusion. Let's hope
it's enough...

message:
Make the subroutines seaice_lsr_tridiagu/v completely unreadable:
modify lsr-algorithm so that it vectorizes AND converges by using a
"zebra" method: split vector loop into two with step size 2; this
solves a general convergence problem for the JFNK solver on a vector
computer. It has the potential to even improve convergence for
non-vector machines, but it does change the results so it is turned
off by default. To turn on define CPP-flags SEAICE_VECTORIZE_LSR and
SEAICE_VECTORIZE_LSR_ZEBRA in SEAICE_OPTIONS.h

  variables of CG2D_I_R (coefficients and preconditioner)
- with these flow directives update_cg2d will always be included in
  tape computations
- include CG2D.h in the_main_loop and forward_step if NONLIN_FRSURF is defined
- store aw/s/c/2d and pw/s/c also for NONLIN_FRSURF in checkpoint_levX_directives.h
- This change fixes a serious bug that caused many configurations with
  non-linear free surface and seaice to blow up in tapelevel 1
  computations, because update_cg2d was not called in
  forward_stepmd. As a consequence, this will change the results of AD
  simulations with non-linear free surface.
- Note: with this fix, simulations will be more stable, but the
  gradients are still wrong, because cg2d_sad implements a self-adjoint 
  version of cg2d, which is only accurate if the non-linear free surface is 
  not used.
* modify 2 experiments to test NLFS in AD properly
* Update reference output
1) update AD and TL output for primary & secondary "seaice" test
   after switching these 2 to nonlinFreeSurf=4 & select_rStar=2 ;
2) Also update other secondary  AD output (changes due to swiching
   nchklev_1 from 1 to 2).
Also add parameter numItersMax in tamc.h (as in pkg/autodiff version)
in case one wants to try ALLOW_CG2D_NSA.

message:
Tut baroclinic gyre (#267)

* work-in-progress baroclini gyre tutorial, through model output section

* model solution section added, various other edits

* minor edits, including openmp now set at two threads for testreport compatibility

* fix data.diagnostics file syntax typo

* swap in/out support data files for new tutorial config

* reduce frequency of checkpoints

* fix dump freq for stat diags, syntax of gluemncbig command

* more syncing of diag parms w/script

* add labels and units to example matlab plots

* change \cal to \mathcal as per @jahn suggestion (fixes pdf problems)

* change to 360-day year; also explicitly set sBeta=0 in data

* mention binary checkpoint output produced

* fix up captions for the file listings

* minor edits following comments, mnc outp should work w/testreport now

* Update comments

Comments in these 2 "eedata" files have not been updated for 13 years:
- take updated version of "eedata" from recently updated "tutorial_barotropic_gyre"
- take updated version of "eedata.mth" from recently updated experiment:
   global_ocean.90x40x15/input/

* add a comment regarding commented lines

* minor edits + add 1 missing ending line comma

- write REAL parameter value with just a dot at the end (instead of ".0")
  as it was already the case for half of the REAL parameter,
- remove un-used/empty "meridWindFile" setting

* slight mod to equations, replace Laplacian with div(Agrad(u)) etc

* New output for this new/updated set-up

- generate new output on reference platform (baudelaire) using
  reference compiler (gfortran)

* fix reference to meridWindFile (no longer specified in data)

* Python version of @jrscott's plotting routines

Reproduces rough versions of the plots. Very little effort has gone into making them pretty.

* fix stat_fields setting

* change D->H for depth var. fix sign of F_theta

* first pass at addressing @jm-c's changes; see post

* add missing png for barotropic gyre config

* add to SIZE.h explanation about multiplying to global domain size (@jm-c 7)

* move matlab and python analysis script files into new analysis subdir

* simplified text to (just) say temp. BC is zero-flux

* do @jm-c's second set of edits, including fix to tut-BT eta eqn

* flipped the colorbar on the surface HF figure and edited caption

* add a ln -s to get gluemncbig locally (user instruction block)

* Use mnc directory flags in tutorial

Testreport requires mnc output to be placed in folders called mnc_test_*. Tutorial now preserves this behaviour. Multiple directories leads to better performance for large setups, and requires only a trivial modification to the `gluemncbig` command.

author: Gael Forget <gforget@mit.edu>
message:
Documenting ALLOW_GENCOST_CONTRIBUTION in ECCO_CPPOPTIONS.h
(see extract below) and adding the ALLOW_GENCOST_FREEFORM sub-option.

C       >>> ALLOW_GENCOST_CONTRIBUTION: interactive way to add basic 2D cost function terms.
C       > In data.ecco, this requires the specification of data file (name, frequency,
C         etc.), bar file name for corresp. model average, standard error file name, etc.
C       > In addition, adding such cost terms requires editing ecco_cost.h to increase
C         NGENCOST, and editing cost_gencost_customize.F to implement the actual
C         model average (i.e. the bar file content).
#undef ALLOW_GENCOST_CONTRIBUTION
C       >>> free form version of GENCOST: allows one to use otherwise defined elements (e.g.
C         psbar and and topex data) while taking advantage of the cost function/namelist slots
C         that can be made available using ALLOW_GENCOST_CONTRIBUTION. To this end
C         ALLOW_GENCOST_CONTRIBUTION simply switches off tests that check whether all of the

author: Timothy Smith <timsmith204@utexas.edu>
message:
Adjoint variables through diagnostics package (#112)

* Add adjoint of state variables to diagnostics list

* Documentation for printing adjoint variables through pkg/diagnostics

* documentation: fixed small timePhase typo

* adj output via netCDF: fixed with diagnostics flag for fwd/reverse mode

* cut line that was longer than 72c

* fix so that it compiles with gfortran

* Minimal diagnostics_write changes, moved adjoint specific writing to diagnostics_write_adj

* Check and stop if adj and fwd variables in same diag list

* Documentation: cannot mix adj and fwd variables in diagnostics

* test for adjoint vars in diags via gcode(4:4)

* Documentation: new adjoint vars in diags use diagCode(4:4)='A'

* Add internal parameter "useDiag4AdjOutp"
  to be set to TRUE when using pkg/diagnostics to output Adjoint variables;
  for now, hard coded according to CPP option DIAGNOSTICS_ADJ_OUTPUT

* Fix some issues related to Adjoint Variable diagnostics:
1) do not try to fill Adj Diags when useDiagnostics=F in data.pkg:
  this is done by testing (new) logical param "useDiag4AdjOutp"
2) fix AdExch options (dumpAdVarExch=1 or 2), need to be applied
 at all time-step for time-averaged diagnostics (and not only if dumpAdVarExch=1
 and time to write)
3) regarding OpenAD, AdjExch S/R might be different so left it empty
 for now, similar to what is done for AdDump:
> C--   need to all the correct OpenAD EXCH S/R ; left empty for now
4) unrelated to Adj Diags: remove foo2D and foo3D and use instead
  local temp variable var2Du & var3Du

* Revert to old diagnostics_out with separate write and write_adj

* adj diags: openAD untested & no divided adjoint

* Alternative implementation of Adjoint-varibles output in pkg/diagnostic
- no need for additional pkg/diagnostics CPP option (DIAGNOSTICS_ADJ_OUTPUT)
- set internal pkg/diagnostics parameter "useDiag4AdjOutp" (from diagnostics_set_pointers.F)
  according to content of data.diagnostics (if Adj-Diags are found).
- go through specific diagnostics filling code (with ad-exch) in addummy_in_stepping.F
  only if needed, i.e. when useDiag4AdjOutp=T.
- add some check & stop in pkg/autodiff and pkg/diagnostics (now also incrementing errCount
  to get all err msg printed).
- simplify diagnostics_write.F & diagnostics_write_adj.F, now testing for time to write
  only once.

* remove declaration of adgt & adgs (were no longer in common block).

* Switch to use pkg/diagnostics with some Adjoint-variable diagnostics
This provides an example (and a test) for Adj-Var diagnostics

* adj diags documentation: don't need DIAGNOSTICS_ADJ_OUTPUT, need ALLOW_AUTODIFF_MONITOR, reference verification example

message:
remove all recomputation warnings and many unnecessary recomputations in pkg/thsice  (#599)

* get rid of recomputations in thsice_solve4temp.F

* get rid of all recomputation warnings in thsice_calc_thickn.F

- clean up store directives
- define new tape comlev1_thsice_nlyr, comment out tape
  comlev1_thsice_2
- some recomputations can be avoided by helper variables, others by
  using vector code

* by-product: avoid unbalanced quotes in comments and trailing blanks

* small adjustment: ALLOW_AUTODIFF -> ALLOW_AUTODIFF_TAMC

* avoid 4 store directives by splitting a loop and helper variables

- splitting the loop is put within ifdef ALLOW_AUTODIFF, because it
  also potentially changes the meaning of an if-statement, but should
  be unproblematic
- change one ALLOW_AUTODIFF_TAMC to ALLOW_AUTODIFF, where no TAF
  specific code is involved
- comment out another now unsed TAF tape (comlev_thsice_1) and add
  comments about that

* adjust store directives to reduce gradient error by 2 orders of mag.

in offline_exf_seaice.thsice from 1.09e-1 to 1.02e-3

* reorganize store directives to avoid recomputing this routine

- remove unnecessary stores and add a few strategically to avoid call
  thsice_calc_thichn and thsice_calc_extend in the ad-routine again
- small changes in the admonitor output, but gradients remain the same.

* avoid unnecessary recomputation in thsice_main_ad, half complete

works for for offline_exf_seaice.thsice, but only halfway for
global_ocean.cs32x15.thise

* more store directives and some cleanup to help TAF

* more rearrangement of store directives to avoid unnecessary recomps

* aviod unnecessary recomputations within thsice_main_ad, completed

- the trick was to store the precipitation fields within
  thsice_balance_frw
- remove many now unnecessary store directives again, replace byte by
  kind parameter

* cleanup to reduce recomputations by more stores

- replace byte by kind parameter
- more store directives, but one call thsice_get_exf cannot still not
  be avoided, maybe later

* fix last recomputation by replacing on iceThick by hIce(i,j)

- cleanup: replace byte by kind parameter; fix some comments unused
  format statement, white spaces and indentation

* Revert "fix last recomputation by replacing on iceThick by hIce(i,j)"

This reverts commit 2b44801b5209173ad309712dfc758d853f8f0b6e.

* fix last recomputation by replacing on iceThick by hIce(i,j)

- cleanup: replace byte by kind parameter; fix some comments unused
  format statement, white spaces and indentation

* storing frenzy: remove 3 store directives and add 19

to avoid recomputing this routine in the ad-version. This might be
excessive as we have now 43 tapes (common blocks) in this routine. Not
sure if this is worth it, but the AD-code is now "clean".

* remove 3 store directives and add 5 new ones: no recomputations left

- exf-variable sh should not and does not need to be stored,
  certainly not 3 times
- 5 new stores avoid recomputing the routine in the ad-code (not
  necessary but reduces runtime a little)
- ssq does not need to be 2D field
- make key computation less cryptic (a little?)
- define new tapes and comment out unused ones in the_main_loop.F

* intermediate state, no recomputation anymore with new flag

- fix bug: define two feilds with fixed boundaries and not as
  (imin:imax,jmin:jmax)
- remove many (14) unnecessary store directives and add 2 new ones
- new flag ALLOW_AUTODIFF_TAMC_MORE is defined locally (hardwired);
  leads to seven additional store directives that avoid calling
  thsice_get_exf in ad-code.

* fix the repercussions of fix the array boundaries in solve4temp

* taking a leap: remove all store directives and let TAF guide me

- fix all recomputation warnings by new (and old) store directives
- add additional store directives to avoid recomputations of routine
  bodies within locally defined ALLOW_AUTODIFF_TAMC_MORE (optional by
  turned on by default
- as a result, the gradients are much better

* replace Tsf by tSrf1 to avoid error in tape computations

- this circumnavigates a TAF bug (or us confusing TAF) and leads to
  correct tape computation and hence better gradients, now comparable
  to (and sometime even better than) TLM

* store directives that avoid recomputation of routine in ad-code

but withing ALLOW_AUTODIFF_TAMC_MORE, undefined for now, because these
directives change the results, needs to be sorted out

* documents which store directives change the results by how much

* get rid of ALLOW_AUTODIFF_TAMC_MORE flag in these routine

undefining this flag actually leads to recomputation warnings, so I
just replace it by ALLOW_AUTODIFF_TAMC

* define ALLOW_AUTODIFF_TAMC_MORE, this changes results a little

- but only if isbyte = 4. For isbyte=8, results remain the same.
- add some comments about this

* set isbyte=8, this changes all results a little

but mainly the ad-monitor output. The AD-gradient remains unchanged
for the default experiment.

* add code within new flag THSICE_AUTODIFF_REGULARIZE

- regularization of sqrt and divisions, replace max by a soft maximum
  function
- this is a by product of my debugging efforts. The changes are not
  strictly necessary, but improve the gradients a little, so I keep
  the code within a CPP flag that can be defined in THSICE_OPTIONS.h

* clean up store directives in thsice_advection/advdiff

- remove unnecessary recomputation thsice_advdiff and thsice_advection
- rename tape for thsice_advection and fix declaration
- fix key computation in thsice_advection

* separate data.grdchk for input_ad.thsice, first attempt

* adjust comment

* declare dummy field as full 2D field with overlaps (for AD only)

apparently some compilers need to this to work after TAF has processed
this

* fix previous commit

* always define tmpFlx as full array and initialise local arrays

per Tim's suggestion, because some compilers (ifort) will not work
without that (and because it makes sense).

* revert thsice_impl_temp.F to master and adjust array boundaries

* Update reference output for ADM & TLM test

- secondary test using pkg/thsice has been updated (data.grdchk) and
  store-dir in pkg/thsice fixed.
- tapes are now written to 64-bit files which change AD monitor of primary
  ADM test.

* Update reference ADM output for secondary thsice test

Store directives in pkg/thsice have been fixed, which affect results
of this ADM test (12 digits matching for AD-grad).

* rename Tsf in TsfDummy, as that's what it is now, adjust comments

so that the print statments correspond more to the printed variable
and break lines longer than 80 characters

* cleanup: remove commented tape initialisations of unused tapes

* Also update TLM reference output of secondary test (with thsice)

It turns out that TL version of thsice_solve4temp.F was not right,
missing update of In/Out argument "tSrf1", which affects the cost fct.
This got fixed by removing the copy tSrf1 <--> Tsf.
Changes to Cost & TLM grad: 9 & 10 digits.

* rename TsfDummy + shorten few arg names

- rename TsfDummy to Tsf_mlt (surface temp metling point)
- rename 3 arguments (dropping suffix "1") to recover original name
  (i.e., before 2013-04-13 renaming) and adjust debug printed msg;
- rename "evap00" to "evap_0" (an other old renaming from Oct 2012);
- re-work argument & local var description, units consistently within
  square brackets, few little improvements;
- finish previous modification regarding replacing "Tsfc" in comments.

* adjust maxcube/maxpass error checks similar to gad/seaice_advection

remove unused i/jMin/Max

* replace maxpass by parameter thSIce_nAdv, fix key computation

adjust checks and error messages

* fix (unused) regularised code

* minor changes

- add a commented line in THSICE_SIZE.h (might be useful one day)
- refine one check & stop in thsice_advection.F

* document fixing TAF store dir in pkg/thsice

author: Alistair Adcroft <aadcroft@princeton.edu>
message:
Implemented new I/O package (mdsio.F). This package does parallel
I/O in much the same way as dfile.F used to except it uses "direct
access" rather than (f77) unformatted sequential access.

Problems with dfile.F package included:
  o unnecessary memory use (each process had two global sized buffers)
  o inability to read the files it had written without post-processing
  o "tiled" files were tiled by process/thread rather than actual tiles
  o created huge numbers of files with no alternatives

Features of the mdsio.F package:
  o direct-access binary writes
  o no excessive memory use
  o ability to read/write from multiple record files
  o "tiled" files are based on "WRAPPER" tiles so that the number
    and content of files is independent of the number of threads
    and/or processes
  o option to create single "global" files rather than "tiled" files
  o ability to read both "global" and "tiled" files
    [Caveat: the tiling of files must match the model tiles]
  o checkpoints now use a single file per model section
    ie.  one file for the hydrostatic model core, one file
    for the non-hydrostatic extensions and one file for the C-D
    extensions
  o the mid-level I/O routines now is broken into more source files
    read_write_fld.F supplies basic I/O routines with the same interface
                     as the original I/O package
    read_write_rec.F supplies I/O routines which allow multiple records
    write_state.F    writes the model state
    checkpoint.F     supplies the read/write checkpoint routines

All the example input data has had to be modified to be direct-access.
Otherwise only routines that used I/O have been affected and not
all of those have been due to the continuity of arguments in
the read_write_fld.F routines.

What needs to be done?  We have to create a suite of conversion
utilities for users with old-style data. Also supply the option
for using old-style I/O, not just for die-hards but for reading
data too extensive to be converted. And more...

author: Martin Losch <30285667+mjlosch@users.noreply.github.com>
message:
obcs balance surface (#251)

* add code to include surface freshwater flux in balancing
  This first version uses PmEpR of the previous time step. This is not
  optimal because it will break restarts, but requires only minimal code
  changes. Properly EmPmR should be used, but then obcs_balance_flow
  needs to be called at the end of do_oceanic_phys, when EmPmR is available.
* second version with proper balance but more code rearragement
* update diverged version to changes pkg/obcs/obcs_calc.F
* move new call to s/r obcs_balance_and_tides
  now it is called right after external_forcing_surf when EmPmR becomes available
* update code to be more consistent with main version
  new code contains only differences specific to the experiment, but
  also contains an extra call to new subroutine
  s/r obcs_balance_and_tides at the end to maintain verification
  experiment accuracy. This is a hack and needs to be revisited, but
  currently this is the only way not to break this experiment.
* describe new parameter OBCSbalanceSurf and fix some formatting
* add mass flux of ice shelf
  This code is intended to balance the incoming mass flux as represented
  by shelfIceDynMassTendency by an extra outflow through the open
  boundaries. A simply diagnostic is included that records the mean sea
  level in ice-shelf-free ocean. The balance is not perfect so far and I
  do not know why.
* small bug fix to allow running the code without pkg/shelfice
* fix previous commit and remove hack that was added but now this is no longer 
  necessary as a missing call to s/r obcs_balance_and_tides has been introduce
  in s/r obcs_init_variables that fixes this problem
  - add runtime parameter exactConserv for consistency
  - rearrange CPP and Fortran ifs a little
  - rename dEtaHdtSum to netFreshWaterFlux
* add melting contribution as negative mass flux and cleanup
  - melting reduces mass flux and needs to be included, this contribution is compensated in EmPmR
  - remove extra output that was there for diagnostic reasons
  - add stubb for pkg/streamice, not sure if this is even remotely correct; commented out for now
* add new test to isomip that tests OBCS_balance_surf code
  - based on isomip.icefront geometry, there is open water for iy>50
  - open boundary along the northern boundary with zero prescribed inflow
  - exactConserv and useRealFreshWaterFlux = .TRUE., non-linear free surface
  - ice mass changes in inclined area by 1e-5*iceMass/deltaT through
    precribed MassDynTendFile
* Tell Travis about the new test
* remove S/R OBCS_BALANCE_AND_TIDES from obcs.F and rename
  - new name OBCS_ADJUST in new file obcs_adjust.F
  - adjust obcs_calc.F version in dome-experiment
  - add new file to diff.list
  - adjust calling tree in do_oceanic_phys.F
* adjust remaining obcs_calc.F private to verification/internal_wave
* add more checks in case of OBCSbalanceSurf = T follow @jm-c's suggestions and
  - add a check if any of the four OBCS_balanceFacE,W,N,S is positive, add a stop if not.
  - reset OBCSbalanceSurf to F if useRealFreshWaterFlux=F
* remove EXACT_CONSERV ifdefs and runtime flags, and more
- replace by useRealFreshWaterFlux, which is implicitly done in S/R
   obcs_check where OBCSbalanceSurf is reset to F is useRealFreshWaterFlux=F
- apply mass2rUnit factor to netFreshWaterFlux and
  shelfIceNetMassFlux (which is also a freshwater flux) instead of
  during the summation. The latter changes the results of isomip.obcs (only
  matching 12 digits), so update reference
* refine test for positive OBCS_balanceFac[E,W,N,S] and add stop
* reduce number of lines by 12 by moving bi/bj-loops
* more robust and simpler check for positive OBCS_balanceFac[E,W,N,S]
* simplify check for positive OBCS_balanceFac[E,W,N,S] even further
  and remove test and stop if EXACT_CONSERV is undefined
* Update output (latest master code merged in)
  Previous output was generated before PR #219 "Mom_diagnostics_and_bottom_stress"
  was merged in, but this set of changes affects results at machine truncation level.
  As a consequence, some output were updated in PR #219 (e.g., isomip.htd) and now,
  since master code has just been merged in, this one need an update too (only 12
  matching digits for cg2d).
* small improvement to warning/error messages
  - avoid potential wrong STOP by re-setting OBCSbalanceSurf to F when useOBCSbalance=F
  - avoid un-used variable ; improve a little Warnings message
* fix for multi-threaded
  Additional check for OBCSbalanceSurf (bi,bj loop and call to GLOBAL_SUM_INT)
  must be done for all threads instead of only Master-thread.
* added for multi-threaded test
* run for only 12 time-step (instead of 20)
* document pkg/obcs new feature "OBCSbalanceSurf"

  - either use homogenous (pseudo) v.Neumann conditions or prescribe
    OB-values from file; this is not different from the way theta and salinity
    are treated

    are really files, otherwise the OB-fields remain untouched. This makes
    it possible to use different OBs at different ends of the domain (as
    with EXF)

    from a file.

author: Martin Losch <30285667+mjlosch@users.noreply.github.com>
message:
improve CG2D adjoint (#470)

* new runtime parameter cg2dFullAdjoint

* implement Tim Smiths scheme full adjoint of cg2d

Use existing infrastructure and adjust flow directives for cg2d
slightly to make taf pass cg2d_x to s/r cg2d_sad. Yet, this is
incomplete, as the solution cg2d_x needs to be recomputed before
passing it to cg2d_sad.
Test this in global_ocean.cs32x15.

* Attempt to force TAF into store cg2d_x at the right place

Am I smarter than TAF? Use store directives and handwritten storing
routine to store cg2d_x after it has been computed, so that we can
restore it in handwritten cg2d_sad. cg2d_x as an explicit is no longer
need and the flow directives have been adjusted accordingly

* remove debugging print statement

* add a comment about adjoint of preconditioner

* adjust some cpp flags

* going around in concentric circles, back to simpler scheme

- only have cg2d_x (initial guess) passed to cg2d_sad (storing cg2d_x in
solve_fore_pressure does not appear to be worth it).
- remove all of the artificial storing aria, TAF was right, as usual
- add some comments to remind me, why things are done the way they are done
- this looks much better, but alas, the gradient checks of botto_ctrl_5x5 tell a
different story (poor, much poorer than with cg2d_nsa)

* revert to original state as it does not need any modifications

* some intermediate state, but with much better gradient checks

- not clear about the exchange of cg2d_b_ad
- restrict loop ranges to 1,sNx/sNy (very important !!!!)
- add output in every timestep but only at high debug level (>=3)

* replace ECCO_CPPOPTIONS.h by CTRL/COST_OPTIONS.h in bottom_ctrl_5x5

requires including additional CTRL_OPTIONS.h in some files

* disentangle NONLIN_FRSURF and ALLOW_DEPTH_CONTROL in on place

as it leads to a compile error when DISABLE_RSTAR_CODE is undef

* bring up to date with default, undef SHORTWAVE_HEATING

* get rid of local version, instead add hfac-output to default version

- not complete, as the diagnostics package variables are not defined

* new flag useNSACG2D solver to be able to switch cg-solver at runtime

- mainly for debugging

* replace cg2d by cg2d_nsa in print statement

* fix a check

* allow to switch between cg2d and cg2d_nsa at runtime

in order not to fiddle with cg2d itself, declare common block fields
cg2d_r/s again as cg2d_rf/sf as full 2D fields with full overlap, as
required by cg2d_nsa

* fix a cpp flag

* add a new verification experiment that tests cg2dFullAdjoint = T

- differs from the baseline experiment by having
useNSACGSolver=.False., and cg2dFullAdjoint = .TRUE.,
- doing the same twice with different results a poorer gradient checks
- need to think about the names of these parameters
- so far no reference results

* add some forgotting initialisation

* small adjustment of store directives for matric coefficients

avoid calling update_cg2d by moving store directives

* add new paramter cg2dMinItersNSA and test in bottom_ctrl_5x5

- enforcing a minimum number of iterations of 10 in bottom_ctrl_5x5
  improves gradient checks by 3 orders of magnitude, because now the
  solver does something even for timestep 1
- avoid divisions by zero if running idle

* recompute cg2d_x in cg2d_sad for cg2dFullAdjoint

- finally allows accurate gradients
- requires passing cg2d_b to S/R cg2d_sad

* store cg2d_x manually by adding a routine with flow directives

Again going around in circles because we had something like this
earlier. Now new s/r cg2d_store is called from solve_for_pressure,
solve_for_pressuremd, but not from solve_for_pressure_ad. Saves us
recomputing cg2d_x in cg2d_sad.

* Add a TAF INCOMPLETE statement for recip_hFacs

to make sure they are properly recomputed and the AD contributions are
added to the hfacs lateron

* set up global_ocean.90x40x15.bottomdrag to test cg2dFullAdjoint

- nonlinFreeSurf=4 (was 2)
- data.grdchk: grdchk_eps = 1.e-4 (was 1.e-2) to get more accurate
  FD-gradients. With this change, the relative accuracy changes by one
  order of magnitude (from 2e-6 to 1.7e-7)

* looking forward: define NONLIN_FRSURF and do not disable rStar code

with the additional store directives, bottom_ctrl_5x5 compiles and
runs with nonlinear free surface and rStar code compiled (not tested
yet).

* define local parameters for key computations after merge

* adjust common blocks and common block names to get sensible output

- fix a flag in addummy_in_stepping

* remove commented code

* rename cg2d_sad.F into cg2d_mad.F and adjust some comments

* revert earlier: remove cg2dFullAdjoint=.TRUE. from data.autodiff

* fix spelling error

* New and updated reference output

- add ADM & TLM output for new test experiment "bottom_ctrl_5x5.facg2d"
- update reference ADM & TLM output of experiment bottom_ctrl_5x5 (primary test)
  and global_ocean.90x40x15.bottomdrag

Comparing with older ADM ref. output (on villon):
Y Y Y Y 15> 2< 4 -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- FAIL  bottom_ctrl_5x5  (e=0, w=4, lfd=1, dop=1, sm=0)
Y Y Y Y  4> 2< 3  2  2  2  3  3  2  2  3  3  2  2  3  3  3  2  3 FAIL  global_ocean.90x40x15.bottomdrag

* Set new run-time param useNSACGSolver to TRUE

Using Non-Self-Adjoint (NSA) cg2d solver was switched-on when corresponding
CPP option ALLOW_CG2D_NSA was defined. This has changed and now requires,
in addition to CPP option, the (new) run-time param useNSACGSolveri to be set to TRUE.

* Remove from common block CG2D working-arrays

Working arrays that need to be EXCH were kept in common block, in CG2D.h ;
This is necessary for multi-threaded run using useCubedSphereExchange without pkg/exch2
(i.e., using EXCH1_RX_CUBE S/R); since other pieces of code are already applying EXCH
to local variable (i.e., not in common block), remove these working arrays from common
block in CG2D.h and declare them as local variable inside each CG2D S/R.
Note: if one really needs to bring back this multi-threading capability, it's easy to
add a local common block inside the CG2D S/R itself (rather than in CG2D.h).

* simplify the selection of which CG2D S/R to call

* Define DISCONNECTED_TILES to get this code tested

Compile DISCONNECTED_TILES code in at least one experiment ; it also run
using this code but since domain has only 1 column it's not a sharp test.

* Update some comments

1) update comments about ALLOW_CG2D_NSA (not necessary "Use" NSA code
   if defined since there is a new run-time switch)
2) add 1 line of comment for DISABLE_RSTAR_CODE & DISABLE_SIGMA_CODE

* Remove CPP option when checking 1 pair of params

It's useful to get all the errors the first time:
e.g., with default CPP_OPTIONS: ALLOW_SRCG defined and ALLOW_CG2D_NSA undef,
it trying to use: useSRCGSolver=T & useNSACGSolver=T, would have stopped without
the error regarding both run-time switch set to T.
With this change, get the 2 error messages right away.

* Retire un-used parameters: cg2dChkResFreq & cg3dChkResFreq

* document adding CG2D full-adjoint code

* update name of GRID common block

so that it matches declaration in GRID.h
